evidence.reason: The denylist workflow runs gitleaks directly in the checked-out PR tree without removing or replacing a head-controlled `.gitleaksignore`. Gitleaks v8.30.1 loads that file by default, so a PR can add a secret and its fingerprint to suppress the finding while the required denylist check remains green. This defeats the existing fail-closed denylist requirement; the smallest compatible repair is to delete or replace the file before every gitleaks scan.
